# Summary

Describe the problem and the observable outcome this pull request delivers.

## Related Intake

Link the related issue, experiment, approved intake exception, or owner request.

## Change Classification

Record the change level and why that level applies. If the level changed during
implementation, explain the approved follow-up decision.

## Approved Governance Artifacts

- Approved specification:
- Approved implementation plan:
- Architecture approval, when Level 3 applies:
- ADRs, when required:

Checked boxes and PR text do not approve a specification, architecture decision,
implementation plan, merge, release, or any other owner decision. Those
approvals remain separate repository-owner actions.

## Scope and Deviations

Confirm that the change matches the approved scope. Disclose every deviation,
limitation, skipped task, or follow-up needed for review.

## Verification Evidence

Record the exact tests, builds, static checks, evaluation runs, and manual
reviews that executed. Include command names, outcomes, failures, skips, and
limitations. Do not treat a green workflow or checked box as a substitute for
the exact evidence.

## Security, Privacy, Data, and Trust Boundaries

Summarize the security, privacy, secret, user-data, prompt/content, memory,
retrieval, and trust-boundary impact. Confidential vulnerability evidence
belongs in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), not in this public PR. Use redacted or
synthetic public evidence only.

## Migration, Compatibility, Operations, and Rollback

Describe schema/data migrations, compatibility impact, deployment/operator
impact, recovery path, and rollback evidence. State `none` only when the
approved scope and verification support it.

## Documentation

Link canonical documentation updated by this change, or explain why no
documentation update is required.

## Dependencies, Models, Datasets, and Provenance

List dependency, model, dataset, generated-artifact, external-content, license,
and third-party provenance changes. Link [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
when notice or attribution review is affected.

## Repository-owner Change-set Review

Record whether the repository owner reviewed the exact change set, including
untracked files, before the Git delivery action that created this PR when
governance requires that review.
